    t.pickup_date,
    t.pickup_dow,
    COUNT(*) AS trips_in_window,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.pickup_hour) AS hours_in_window,
    COUNT(*)::FLOAT / COUNT(DISTINCT t.pickup_hour) AS trips_per_hour
FROM investigator.trips t
WHERE 
    t.pickup_date IN ('2024-07-27','2024-07-31')
    AND t.pickup_hour BETWEEN 12 AND 23
    AND t.is_valid_trip
GROUP BY t.pickup_date, t.pickup_dow", "why": "This query computes the hourly trip rate (trips per hour) for each focus day within the like-for-like 12–23 window.
